subject: Payment instrument fingerprint rotation & 3DS fallback coordination
messages:
From: Sarah Greene <sarah@sage-pay.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: accounts-payable@atlasretail.com
Date: 2027-07-19T09:21:00-07:00
Subject: Failed captures from Atlas Retail — potential chargebacks

Hi Jonas,

We saw a batch of failed captures for Atlas Retail on 2027-07-18 (3 transactions, same BIN). The issuer flagged them as potential fraudulent — two were reversed by cardholder disputes and one is still pending. The acquirer is requesting the merchant to provide prior auth data and evidence that the card on file is the latest instrument (fingerprint).

Can Redwood provide:
- The original payment method fingerprint + last 4
- Any recent card-update/rotation events tied to their account
- Signed invoices for Jul invoices (invoice_4678)

This will help with chargeback rebuttals. If you prefer, we can accept a single zip with supporting docs.

Thanks,
Sarah Greene
Payments Ops, Sage Pay
sarah@sage-pay.com

Attachment: none
From: jonas.weber@redwood.com
To: Sarah Greene <sarah@sage-pay.com>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.com, sean.gallagher@redwood.com
Date: 2027-07-19T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Failed captures from Atlas Retail — potential chargebacks

Hi Sarah — thanks for the heads up.

Quick answers:
- We can extract the payment instrument fingerprint and the last-4; will provide a transaction map.
- Atlas has a scheduled card rotation that ran 2027-07-17 at 02:30 UTC; looks like one charge fell into a race window.
- I'll attach the signed invoice and a bundle of our evidence package.

Kimberly, Sean — can you pull the instrument records and the rotation log for acct atl-001 and confirm which transaction IDs correspond to the rotated instrument?

Jonas Weber
Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
From: accounts-payable@atlasretail.com
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com, kimberly.park@redwood.com
Date: 2027-07-20T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Failed captures from Atlas Retail — potential chargebacks

Jonas & team,

Thanks — we'll accept the evidence bundle. Note that the chargeback window for TXN 786542 expires 2027-07-25; the issuer said they need the signed invoice + proof of token/fingerprint update by then.

Also, are you able to confirm whether the rotation was server-initiated (platform) or user-submitted? Our internal PCI records differ.

Regards,
Maya Patel
AP Lead, Atlas Retail
From: kimberly.park@redwood.com
To: Sarah Greene <sarah@sage-pay.com>, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: sean.gallagher@redwood.com
Date: 2027-07-21T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Failed captures from Atlas Retail — potential chargebacks

Hi Sarah — attaching the evidence bundle now.

Included:
- invoice_4678.pdf (signed by Atlas PO)
- instrument_map.csv (instrument_id, fingerprint, last4, created_at)
- rotation_log.txt (timestamped events showing server-initiated rotation at 2027-07-17T02:30:43Z)
- chargeback_evidence_pkg.zip (merchant receipt, delivery confirmation)

Summary: rotation was platform-initiated due to expiring token renewal; rotation completed before 2027-07-17T03:00Z. One capture attempt occurred at 2027-07-17T02:46Z overlapping the rotation TTL — that is likely the failed capture.

Please confirm receipt and whether you need a tailored cover letter for the acquirer.

Kimberly Park
Payments Strategy, Redwood Inference
Attachment: invoice_4678.pdf; chargeback_evidence_pkg.zip
From: Sarah Greene <sarah@sage-pay.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: 2027-07-23T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Failed captures from Atlas Retail — potential chargebacks

Kimberly,

Received everything — clean package. The acquirer accepted the server-initiated rotation evidence and has closed TXN 786542 without a chargeback after review. They asked we standardize the cover letter format for future disputes; I'll share the template.

Thanks for the quick turnaround, and please route any similar rotation windows to our Ops queue in advance if possible.

Best,
Sarah
Payments Ops, Sage Pay
